test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Extinct
solution: The correct answer is: **Vanished**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A synonym is a word having the same or nearly the same meaning as another word. • **Extinct **means no longer in existence or happening. (अब अस्तित्व में नहीं है या घटित नहीं हो रहा है) • **Example**: *Many ancient languages have become extinct, their words and grammar structures lost to history.* • Marked option **Vanished **means disappeared suddenly and completely. (अचानक और पूरी तरह से गायब हो गया) • **Example**: *The treasure chest, hidden for centuries, suddenly vanished without a trace.* • So, 'vanished' is a suitable synonym for 'extinct'. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Vibrant **means full of energy and enthusiasm. (ऊर्जा और उत्साह से भरपूर) • **Active **means engaged in physical or mental activity. (शारीरिक या मानसिक गतिविधि में लगे हुए) • **Living **means having life or being alive. (जीवन होना या जीवित होना) 13a:Tbdf, The correct answer is: **Praise**.
